title: TokenTimelineBucket
description: One (project, time-bucket) cell in the workspace token timeline served by GET /api/workspace/tokens/timeline. Sibling of token-aggregate.schema.json: same fields, finer time slice. Bucketed live from the orchestrator log (logs/.orchestrator/orchestrator.jsonl on each watched project), so the values reflect orchestrator LLM calls only - per-task agent CLI usage stays on the per-card token bubble. Total token counts are authoritative; dollars are a theoretical Anthropic-rate estimate, not the user's bill.

project.description: Project name (matches WatchPathEntry.Name), used to map the cell to its colour in the chart legend.

bucketStart.description: Inclusive UTC start of the bucket. Aligned to the request's bucketMinutes (5 / 15 / 60).

bucketEnd.description: Exclusive UTC end of the bucket.

calls.description: Number of orchestrator LLM calls that fell into this bucket for this project.

input.description: Sum of input tokens across the calls in this bucket.

cacheRead.description: Sum of prompt-cache read tokens (10% of input rate at Anthropic prices).

cacheWrite.description: Sum of prompt-cache write tokens (125% of input rate, 5-minute writes).

total.description: input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite. The chart's primary metric.

dollars.description: Theoretical USD estimate for this bucket using Anthropic's published per-million-token rates. Null when none of the calls in the bucket used a priced model. Covers only the priced subset when allModelsPriced is false.

allModelsPriced.description: True when every call in this bucket used a model in the pricing catalog. False means the dollar number is partial; consumers should annotate the cell.
